senses.gloss: €1P. (गञ्जति) To sound, sound in a particular way.

__1 A mine. 
__2 A treasury; निर्मूषके राजगञ्जे [[Ks. 43. 30.]] 
__3 A cow-house. 
__4 A mart, a place where grain is stored for sale. 
__5 Disrespect, contempt. 
-ञ्जा 
__1 A hut, hovel. 
__2 A tavern. 
__3 A drinking vessel. 
__4 A mine, jewel mine. 
-जम् 
__1 A mine. 
__2 A treasury. 
-Comp. 
-वरः a treasurer (from Persian) [[EI. IX. 247]], [[RT. VII. 42.]]

a. 
__1 Contemning, putting to shame, surpassing, excelling; स्थलकमलगञ्जनं मम हृदयरञ्जनम् (चरणद्वयम्) [[Gīt. 10]]; अलिकुलगञ्जनमञ्जनकम् 12; नेत्रे खञ्जनगञ्जने [[S. D.]]; युष्मत्कृते खञ्जनगञ्जनाक्षि शिरो मदीयं यदि याति यातु [[Udb.]] 
__2 Defeating, conquering; कालियविषधरगञ्जन [[Gīt. 1.]]
